note: The quantified body length is computed from the input regex AST and drives later emptiness classification.
When the body can be empty, the quantifier is marked as possibly empty instead of proving it is non-empty.
The emptiness flag propagates the quantifier node as the empty-repeat carrier for later backreference handling.
The empty-repeat carrier is stored on the referenced capture so backreferences can consult it.
The stored node is read back during backreference processing, enabling use of a node that may already be freed or invalidated.
